status.current_claim: The current four-layer 157x7x7x53 PTCNA-shaped runtime is historical pre-audit experimental scaffolding. Its frozen 18-case role-acquisition result remains sealed: target accuracy 0.3333333333 versus 0.9444444444 for the hashed-linear fallback, so both declared usefulness and superiority claims are FALSIFIED for that exact scaffold and scope. The intended PTCNA has not yet been built: UCNS must first audit a functioning conventional neural network and provide source-bound relational construction evidence. The intended language primitive is a UCNS Unicode-character gonol, not the scaffold's whole-string SHA feature representation.
